messages.text:
The current failures are at the lexer boundary, not downstream commands: quoted JSON and Nushell backtick escapes need to preserve the same characters the reference parser sees.

I’m fixing that parser boundary first, then I’ll run subprocess-based differential checks so PowerShell quoting does not become a false failure source.

FAIL math invalid: 1 / 'x'
  ref=(1, '', "Error: nu::parser::operator_unsupported_type

  x The '/' operator does not work on values of type 'string'.
   ,-[source:1:3]
 1 | 1 / 'x'
   :   | ^|^
   :   |  `-- string
   :   `-- does not support 'string'
   `----

")
  got=(1, '', 'Error: incompatible types
')
FAIL math invalid: 9 bit-shl -2
  ref=(1, '', 'Error: nu::shell::operator_overflow

  x Operator overflow.
   ,-[source:1:3]
 1 | 9 bit-shl -2
   :   ^^^|^^^
   :      `-- right operand to bit-shl exceeds available bits in underlying data
   `----
  help: Limit operand to 0 <= rhs < 64

')
  got=(1, '', 'Error: exceeds available bits
')

   `----
